stage: E1-task-qualification and conditional Z1 paired Reach
standing_contract: Use the scene-specific frozen source, fixed base command, student-owned reset and authenticated open gripper. Establish a legal stationary initial receipt and a 1s stable four-foot dwell. Measure start TCP and entry base. Initialize all source and task clocks at that entry. No teacher fallback or privileged object pose for the policy.
task: Reach toward the red cube and stop before touching it. H0 reference translates 20 mm over 4s with a minimum jerk scalar, in the direction of the archived pregrasp from the measured stable start. Carry the last consumed reference offset once, keep orientation and base reference constant. Re-run geometric sweep at the actual entry and every issued preview.
original_rejection: G7/H40, joint, orientation, speed, acceleration, TTL and consumed seam enforce original bounds. Only four feet/floor and the two stationary cube/table contacts allowed. Require positive clearance from either cube throughout; registration minimum 15 mm from any robot collision geom to either cube. Abort on invalid identity, STOP, resource expiry or forbidden contact.

success.student_success_also_requires: At least one new image/state → second genuine network forward AFTER actual source motion. No credit for alignment motion.

calibration.note: Historical drift and two entry localization errors inform prospective cutoffs. Re-evaluate visibility and clearance before dispatch, preserve failed entries; outside-domain refusal counts.

Q_E1.requires: new allocation, fresh world lease per slot, exact receiver and actual owner, prior read-only rehearsal. Q_STOP requires measured motion and an in-flight reference, real trace STOP, zero subsequent integration/installation, clean reset/process exit. Empty/no-motion fault fails. A failed qualification seals E1/Z1. Score starts independently, no replacements.
Q_E1.fault: At entry + 1,000 ticks while the reference is moving, inject one last authenticated gripper command with a 21 ms lifetime within the original 400 ms ceiling and suppress its renewal. Issue the normal outstanding 25-tick grant. On the 2 ms grid expect rejection at entry+1,011; inspect every actual native integration and every install afterward. Abort unqualified if source/actual movement or an in-flight reference is absent at injection.

Z1.requires: independent or explicit conditional scientific allocation, both E1 layouts qualified, current GPU and world leases, complete RGB/Memory history and actual-state monitor, clock/owner & no-motion controls. Archive calls, returns, installs, consumed source motion, second actual post-motion query and task outcome on every slot. Paired H0 are additional scored runs.

B: historical mobile or unmatched decoder; no B slot
failure_policy: Keep screened, interrupted, failed and unstarted slots separate. No optional B, training, contact or robot hardware under either stage.
